verdict.rationale: Publishing current processing times is a fair question for a state business-filing office, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows the service publishing processing times for any transaction type. The cited items cover Gateway portal enhancements, OHID sign-in and tax-department services. The probes record that ohiosos.gov and the Ohio Business Central filing portal returned 403 at robots.txt, so nothing on those hosts was read; that is why confidence is medium rather than high.
